title: 卖了两个产品套现5600万，他说再也不要了
title_en: Sold Two Products for $56M, Said Never Again

{"ops": [{"insert": "卖了两个产品套现5600万，他说再也不要了"}, {"insert": "
", "attributes": {"header": 1}}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "11周做11个产品，第11个成功了，但他后悔了", "attributes": {"bold": true}}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "Tibo在2015-2019年间做了几个startups，但都没generate revenue，差点放弃。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "2021年，他和联合创始人Tom开始疯狂挑战——每周做一个产品，直到有收入。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "做了10个，全是crickets。但第11个，"}, {"insert": "Tweet Hunter", "attributes": {"bold": true}}, {"insert": "，起飞了。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "这个work了，是因为differentiation。其他产品focus on being best scheduling experience，但Tweet Hunter帮人们come up with better content。不只是scheduler。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "Plus，move faster than everyone else。Shipping more，experimenting with more growth tactics。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "二、"}, {"insert": "
", "attributes": {"header": 2}}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "Tweet Hunter后，又launch了Taplio。Peak时，Tweet Hunter月入30万，Taplio月入60万。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "Eventually，打包卖了。"}, {"insert": "售价800万美元", "attributes": {"bold": true}}, {"insert": "——200万 upfront，最多800万performance-based。Performance bonus拿到了600万，总共5600万人民币左右。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "听起来很棒对吧？但他说："不是super pleasant experience。""}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "为什么？"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "第一，放弃了对他很重要的东西。", "attributes": {"bold": true}}, {"insert": " 他的"baby"，现在看到new owners screwing things up。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "第二，一次性拿到太多钱。", "attributes": {"bold": true}}, {"insert": " 不是坏事，但发现over time earn更健康。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "第三，为了high multiple，选了performance-based earnout。", "attributes": {"bold": true}}, {"insert": " 必须hit很高的revenue milestones，stressful两年。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "所以，"}, {"insert": "不打算再卖了。", "attributes": {"bold": true}}, {"insert": " 想keep building apps，reach slow、continuous growth，live off profit。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "三、"}, {"insert": "
", "attributes": {"header": 2}}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "现在做三个产品，都卖给creators和solopreneurs："}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "revid.ai", "attributes": {"bold": true, "list": "ordered"}}, {"insert": "（原Typeframes）——2023年9月收购。Short viral videos from scratch，月入1.8万。", "attributes": {"list": "ordered"}}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "   收购时还在做earnout，没时间从零build。买的时候月入不到1000，还不是recurring。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "feather.so", "attributes": {"bold": true, "list": "ordered"}}, {"insert": "——2024年4月收购。Notion里建blog，月入9000。", "attributes": {"list": "ordered"}}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "   收购因为真的喜欢这app。喜欢怎么built的。想更快——买user base和PMF，当时已经月入6000-7000。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "superx.so", "attributes": {"bold": true, "list": "ordered"}}, {"insert": "——2024年6月创建。Twitter audience growth tools，月入800。", "attributes": {"list": "ordered"}}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "收购标准："}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "技术栈匹配：基本是Next.JS", "attributes": {"list": "bullet"}}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "有收入和PMF", "attributes": {"list": "bullet"}}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "有清晰的10x收入计划。不为slight increase买", "attributes": {"list": "bullet"}}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "四、"}, {"insert": "
", "attributes": {"header": 2}}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "计划keep products coming。Ideas endless。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "认为founders想太多该做什么不该做什么。真相是永远不会知道。"}, {"insert": "Just do more and ship more。", "attributes": {"bold": true}}, {"insert": " 多数情况下，会对什么work感到surprised。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "If trouble coming up with ideas，just start something。Coming up with ideas开始前feel hard，但开始后feel incredibly easy。和users的对话尤其create continuous flow of ideas。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "Keep two things in mind："}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "Ideas保持在niche内", "attributes": {"list": "bullet"}}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "在stack内build。所有东西用NextJS + Firebase。最comfortable的——像Levels说的，不在stack上innovate。", "attributes": {"list": "bullet"}}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "唯一validation是"}, {"insert": "revenue。", "attributes": {"bold": true}}, {"insert": " Failures和successes最大区别之一，就是successes把revenue当validation。这样避免了free users的"I would pay if"。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "五、"}, {"insert": "
", "attributes": {"header": 2}}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "Build in public", "attributes": {"bold": true}}, {"insert": "最work。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "开始Tweet Hunter时，完全没有following。是build in public的行为带来了following。所以最好建议：在Twitter外做interesting的事，然后分享。Following会natural byproduct。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "分享所有做的事，show current users从中得到什么value。意味着tweet、LinkedIn post、newsletter分享。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "Newsletter做两件事：一是在Twitter和LinkedIn上多分享；二是把每个signup产品的用户变成newsletter subscriber。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "六、"}, {"insert": "
", "attributes": {"header": 2}}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "Influencer partnerships", "attributes": {"bold": true}}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "大顿悟时刻：意识到可以和大influencers合作，给他们equity。这让他们比任何sponsored influencer都engaged。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "Tweet Hunter和Taplio增长的重要部分。给了Tweet Hunter 25%、Taplio 30%。交换条件是influencers handle所有promotion、referral programs、marketing campaigns。实际上还是做了很多，但仍然是very successful partnerships。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "If don't have audience，consider doing this。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "现在，自己就是那个influencer。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "七、"}, {"insert": "
", "attributes": {"header": 2}}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "SEO和free tools", "attributes": {"bold": true}}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "另一个大获客渠道。两件事："}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "写targeted keywords的blog posts", "attributes": {"list": "ordered"}}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "Create free tools，aim at ranking、redirect traffic到main software", "attributes": {"list": "ordered"}}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "Try每两周build至少一个。不super-deep keyword analysis，但约20%有solid traffic，compound起来很大。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "不做的：", "attributes": {"bold": true}}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "人们说每个人都该try cold emailing、ads等。Ignore，因为知道自己不擅长，何必bother？"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "八、"}, {"insert": "
", "attributes": {"header": 2}}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "最终建议："}, {"insert": "Go for it。", "attributes": {"bold": true}}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "这是start indie hacking的best time ever。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "是的，first businesses很可能fail，但还是需要build。因为那种experience会让third、fourth、fifth business successful。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "所以start something。尽快expose to world，have fun，listen to feedback，be curious，try niche down到super specific。Eventually，sure will succeed。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "写在最后"}, {"insert": "
", "attributes": {"header": 2}}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "Tibo的故事是brutal honesty——"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "卖了5600万，但不快乐。不是因为钱，是process。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "核心insights——"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "Revenue是唯一validation", "attributes": {"list": "bullet"}}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "Build in public brings following", "attributes": {"list": "bullet"}}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "Influencer equity partnerships work", "attributes": {"list": "bullet"}}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "Free tools compound SEO", "attributes": {"list": "bullet"}}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "Don't do marketing you suck at", "attributes": {"list": "bullet"}}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "Sustainable growth > Exit", "attributes": {"list": "bullet"}}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "最重要的是：他现在选择"}, {"insert": "keep building，live off profit", "attributes": {"bold": true}}, {"insert": "，而不是chase another exit。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "That's freedom。"}, {"insert": "

content_en: Sold two products for 56 million yuan he says never again. 11 weeks 11 products 11th succeeded but he regrets it. Tibo between 2015-2019 did several startups but none generated revenue almost gave up. In 2021 he and cofounder Tom started crazy challenge - make one product per week until revenue. Did 10 all crickets. But 11th Tweet Hunter took off. This worked because differentiation. Other products focused on being best scheduling experience but Tweet Hunter helps people come up with better content. Not just scheduler. Plus move faster than everyone else. Shipping more experimenting with more growth tactics. After Tweet Hunter also launched Taplio. Peak time Tweet Hunter monthly 300k Taplio monthly 600k. Eventually sold as package. Selling price 80.
content_jp: 2つの製品を売って5600万元、彼说是再也不做了.11週間で11の製品、第11が成功したが後悔している.Tiboは2015-2019年にいくつかstartupsをやったが、どれも収益が生まれず、あきらめかけた.2021年、彼と共同創業者のTomは疯狂な挑战を始めた─毎週1つの製品を作り、収益が出るまで.10個やった、全 crickets.でも11個目のTweet Hunterが火了.これがworkしたのはdifferentiation.他の製品は最高のscheduling experienceにfocus لكن Tweet Hunterは人们がより良いcontentを考え出すのを助ける.単なるschedulerじゃない.-plus、移动比其他人都快. Shipping more、 experimenting with more growth tactics.Tweet Hunterの後、Taplioもlaunch.ピーク時 Tweet Hunter月30万、Taplio月60万.最終的にpackagedで卖了.售价80.
content_ar: باع منتجين مقابل 56 مليون يوان يقول لا أبداً. 11 أسبوع 11 منتج 11 نجح لكن يندم. Tibo بين 2015-2019 أنجز عدة شركات ناشئة لكن لم تحقق أي إيرادات كاد يستسلم. في 2021 هو وشريكه Tom بدأا تحدياً مجنوناً - يصنع منتجاً واحداً في الأسبوع حتى يحقق إيرادات. صنع 10 كلهم فشلوا. لكن 11 Tweet Hunter نجح. هذا نجح بسبب التميز. المنتجات الأخرى ركزت على كونها أفضل تجربة جدولة لكن Tweet Hunter يساعد الناس في ابتكار محتوى أفضل. ليس مجرد جدول. زائد يتحرك أسرع من الجميع. يشحن أكثر يجرب المزيد من تكتيكات النمو. بعد Tweet Hunter أطلق أيضاً Taplio. في الذروة Tweet Hunter每月 300k Taplio每月 600k.最终还是 sell as package. سعر البيع 80.
